title: Make a feather stick
kid_text: Shave curls. A grown-up holds the knife.
safety: A blade can cut you. Cut away from your body.

steps.text: Hold the knife the safe way.
Split a dead stick that is off the ground.
Shave thin curls toward the base.
Leave the curls on the stick.
Light the curls at the low end.

mistakes.text: You cut the curls off the stick.
